How to be the uncle
everyone remembers

1. Show up to the birthdays

Every year.
They notice.

2. Teach a real skill

Fishing, riding, building.
Things parents run out of time for.

3. Answer the big questions

Why is the sky blue?
Know a little about everything.
slides.texte_sophia:
3. Answer the big questions

I learn the answers
on the Sophia app first.

slides.texte_overlay:
4. Tell the family stories

Who they come from.
Nobody else will.

5. Keep your promises

"Next weekend" means
next weekend.
